personal.headline: Research Scientist · Cryptanalysis
personal.summary: Logician and research scientist with fifteen years of work on mechanical computation, algorithmic pattern recognition, and the theoretical foundations of programmable machines. Comfortable shipping both paper proofs and production runtimes.

bullets: Thesis on systems of logic based on ordinals; committee of three external examiners.
Independent study on the Entscheidungsproblem and computable functions.

experiences.title: Principal Scientist
bullets: Designed a probabilistic search machine that reduced expected decryption time from weeks to under a day across the standard message corpus.
Led a cross-disciplinary team of 40 mathematicians, linguists, and engineers through a full rewrite of the analysis pipeline.
Authored the internal statistical framework used by four sibling teams; the framework is still the default three years later.
Ran weekly design reviews; introduced a written-first culture that cut re-work by about 30% on tracked initiatives.

experiences.title: Senior Research Engineer
bullets: Specified the Automatic Computing Engine; the specification was adopted across three downstream projects.
Built the first working subroutine library for the in-house machine.
Mentored four junior engineers; two were promoted to senior within the tenure.

experiences.title: Research Fellow
bullets: Published a foundational paper on chemical pattern formation; cited across three adjacent disciplines.
Built an early chess-playing program on a stored-program machine.

projects.title: Universal Machine Simulator
bullets: Reference implementation of a universal computing machine used in two graduate courses.
Documentation used by an independent textbook; generated its first royalty cheque.
